rules.statement: The onus is on the plaintiff to prove that they were the owner of the premises as of January 1, 1980, for the purpose of section 2(4)(c) of the Rent Act.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where exemption from the Rent Act is claimed on the basis of section 2(4)(c) of the Rent Act the onus is on the plaintiff to prove, (i) that the premises were residential premises, (ii) that the plaintiff was in occupation of the premises on 1st January, 1980, (iii) that the plaintiff was in occupation of the premises on 01 January 1980 in the capacity of owner."
